transcript.note: Principle 3 (shrink the grid) + principle 4 (shorten the routes), applied to the only free tail in the network. The layout arrives with hv 19/20 and a single 45 degree segment 8-3; a per-cell legality scan of every vertex against every cell showed hv can never exceed 19 here, because this is a shape-rect city and the guard pins both ends of that segment: vertex 3 is a ring member (single-vertex moves are vetoed, members may only translate rigidly), and vertex 8 is fixed by member-incident H/V edge locks in both axes at once - row 3 by 4-8 and 8-16, column 1 by 8-7. So this round spends itself on size instead. The column-2 stub north of the ring (5 at (2,6), 9 at (2,7), 1 at (2,8)) was hanging one row too far north, leaving row 5 empty between the ring and the stub: 5 -> (2,5), 9 -> (2,6), 1 -> (2,7) pulls the whole stub one row south, keeping all three segments 5-3, 9-5 and 1-9 vertical, shortening 5-3 from a 2-cell span to 1, and closing the empty band from the inside rather than leaning on compaction to remove it. Nothing else in the network can move: 2, 8 and 10 are locked by member-incident edge locks, 12 has no move that keeps hv at 19 and shrinks anything, and the remaining 10 vertices are ring members.
transcript.noteZh: 本輪走原則三（縮小格網）與原則四（縮短路線），對象是網絡裡唯一還能動的尾巴。起點 hv 19/20，唯一未對齊的是 45 度的 8-3；逐點逐格掃過 validMove 後確認此處 hv 不可能超過 19——這是 shape-rect 城市，護欄把那一段的兩端都釘死了：頂點 3 是環成員（單點移動一律否決，成員只准整體剛體平移），頂點 8 則被成員相連的 H/V 邊鎖同時鎖住兩軸——4-8 與 8-16 鎖住列 3、8-7 鎖住欄 1。所以本輪改為處理尺寸。環北側那條欄 2 的尾巴（5 在 (2,6)、9 在 (2,7)、1 在 (2,8)）多掛了一列，使列 5 在環與尾巴之間空著：5 -> (2,5)、9 -> (2,6)、1 -> (2,7) 把整條尾巴往南收一列，5-3、9-5、1-9 三段仍為垂直，5-3 的跨距由 2 格縮為 1 格，並且是從內部把空帶收掉，而不是靠壓縮事後移除。其餘都動不了：2、8、10 被成員相連的邊鎖鎖住，12 沒有任何既保住 hv 19 又能縮小尺寸的落點，剩下 10 個點都是環成員。

transcript.note: Closing note, no moves. After round 1 the layout is at its structural floor: hv 19/20, grid 5x8, emptyCols and emptyRows both empty so compaction has nothing left to take. I re-ran the per-cell legality scan against the round-1 state - every vertex against every cell of the 5x8 grid, through validMove - and 14 of the 17 vertices are pinned outright. The three that can still move cannot help: vertex 1 (terminus) has only sideways landings that keep hv 19 without vacating any band, since its row and the columns on offer are all occupied by other points; vertex 9's every landing drops hv to 18 or 17; vertex 12's hv-19 landings all move it further north up column 4, lengthening 10-12 and vacating nothing. The single unaligned segment 8-3 stays 45 degrees for the reason given in round 1 - vertex 3 is a ring member and vertex 8 is locked in both axes by member-incident H/V edges - so no batch, however split or shortened, can reach hv 20 while the shape guard holds. Grid floor confirmed independently: rows 0-4 are all occupied by pinned ring members and the column-2 stub needs 3 distinct rows above them, so 8 rows; columns 0-3 hold pinned members and vertex 10 is fixed at column 4 by the 16-10 H lock plus the quadrant rule, so 5 columns. Stopping at 1 round rather than spending two no-improvement rounds proving by trial what the scan already proves exhaustively.
transcript.noteZh: 收尾註記，不移動任何點。第一輪之後佈局已到結構下限：hv 19/20、格網 5x8，emptyCols 與 emptyRows 皆空，壓縮已無可取。我對第一輪後的狀態重跑逐點逐格的合法性掃描——17 個點對 5x8 每一格逐一過 validMove——其中 14 個點完全動不了。剩下三個也幫不上忙：頂點 1（末端站）只有橫向落點能維持 hv 19，但它的列與可去的欄都還有別的點佔著，空不出任何一帶；頂點 9 的每一個落點都讓 hv 掉到 18 或 17；頂點 12 能維持 hv 19 的落點全是沿欄 4 再往北，只會拉長 10-12 而且空不出東西。唯一未對齊的 8-3 維持 45 度，理由同第一輪——頂點 3 是環成員、頂點 8 被成員相連的 H/V 邊在兩軸同時鎖死——所以只要形狀護欄還在，無論怎麼拆批、怎麼縮短距離都到不了 hv 20。格網下限另行獨立確認：列 0-4 全被釘死的環成員佔滿，欄 2 的尾巴還需要其上三個相異列，故 8 列；欄 0-3 有釘死的成員，頂點 10 又被 16-10 的 H 鎖加象限規則固定在欄 4，故 5 欄。既然掃描已窮盡證明，就停在 1 輪，不再花兩輪用試誤重證一次。
